archetypes.name: White-Blue Flyers
archetypes.plan: Build around Thunderclap Wyvern: Hold the ground with defensive creatures and interaction while a concentrated suite of flyers wins overhead.

archetypes.name: Blue-Black Graveyard
archetypes.plan: Build around Possessed Skaab: Stock the graveyard through looting and self-mill, then recur threats or cash in cards from the graveyard.

archetypes.name: Black-Red Sacrifice
archetypes.plan: Build around Blazing Hellhound: Feed expendable creatures to sacrifice outlets so death triggers and drain effects turn every trade into reach.

archetypes.name: Red-Green Creature Ramp
archetypes.plan: Build around Zendikar Incarnate: Accelerate with mana creatures, curve into oversized threats, and use trample effects to close through blockers.

archetypes.name: Green-White Renown
archetypes.plan: Build around Citadel Castellan: Use tricks and removal to push creatures through once, then leverage their renown counters to control combat.

archetypes.name: White-Black Auras
archetypes.plan: Build around Blood-Cursed Knight: Enhance a protected creature with Auras, recur lost enchantments when possible, and win through lifelink or evasion.

archetypes.name: Blue-Red Artifacts
archetypes.plan: Build around Reclusive Artificer: Combine cheap artifacts with cards that trigger from casting or sacrificing them, then win through tempo and reach.

archetypes.name: Black-Green Elves
archetypes.plan: Build around Shaman of the Pack: Fill the battlefield with Elves, exploit tribal mana and card advantage, then attack with a wide enhanced team.

archetypes.name: Red-White Aggro
archetypes.plan: Build around Iroas's Champion: Curve low-cost attackers into combat tricks and burn, widening the board enough to punish slow starts.

archetypes.name: Green-Blue Tempo
archetypes.plan: Build around Bounding Krasis: Deploy efficient creatures, hold up bounce or flash threats, and keep the opponent off balance long enough to race.
